title: The Pirate Treasure Nobody Came Back For
description:
Captain Mara buried her treasure on Skull Beach in 1720 and never came back. One cabin boy kept the map his whole life.

#shorts #pirates #treasure #story

scenes.title: she never came back
scenes.voice: Captain Mara buried her treasure on Skull Beach in 1720. She never came back for it. Nobody knows why.
scenes.image_prompt: Pirate captain Mara, red bandana and long dark braid, burying a wooden treasure chest on a golden beach at sunset, palm trees, her red-sailed ship anchored in the turquoise bay

scenes.title: the fastest ship
scenes.voice: Her ship, the Red Gull, was the fastest in the Caribbean. Forty pirates, one parrot, and a map that only Mara could read.
scenes.image_prompt: The Red Gull, a pirate ship with bright red sails racing over turquoise waves under a clear sky, captain Mara in her red bandana at the wheel, a green parrot on her shoulder, crew hauling ropes

scenes.title: three days of storm
scenes.voice: Then came the storm. Three days of black waves and lightning. The Red Gull went down with everyone on board, except one cabin boy.
scenes.image_prompt: The red-sailed pirate ship Red Gull tossed by huge black waves in a night storm, lightning splitting the sky, torn sails, a small cabin boy clinging to the mast, dramatic and moody

scenes.title: the same beach
scenes.voice: That boy grew old with the map in his pocket. He drew it a hundred times, and every copy pointed to the same beach.
scenes.image_prompt: An old sailor with a white beard, the grown-up cabin boy, unrolling a worn treasure map on a table in a lantern-lit ship cabin, a green parrot perched beside him, warm candlelight

scenes.title: still there?
scenes.voice: So is the treasure still there? Follow, and next time we dig up Skull Beach.
scenes.image_prompt: Golden beach at dawn with a half-buried wooden treasure chest spilling gold coins into the sand, palm trees, a shovel, the red-sailed ship far out on a calm turquoise sea
scenes.detail: Loop ending: the question sends the viewer back to the buried chest.
